algorithm: ordinary bias-corrected AdamW, stock Gaussian initialization, production minibatches
seed_law: 11 fresh independent uniform u32 draws with replacement, fixed before training
outcome: From an imperfect initial hidden table to the first strict 4656/4656 hidden predictions by the cap. Independently reload weights and verify every rival using labels reconstructed from the 4656 observed equations.
handling: One trajectory per seed. Count a miss or a hardware interruption as failure. Count the first hit once, then stop. No noise, restart or between-seed selection. Report all 11 trials.
inference: Single prespecified primary endpoint. Under independent identically distributed whole trials and success probability at most 3/4, the probability of eleven passes is at most (3/4)^11.
